subject: deployApp() error: file is not readable

messages.author: d891098130aebcac
messages.subject: deployApp() error: file is not readable
parts:
Whenever I try to deploy an app I get an error stating that my ui.R and server.R files are unreadable. I'm a little new to R and very new to shiny, so perhaps the problem will be obvious to others. I think I've set up my account info and devtools correctly based on the guide (https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/guide/guide.md) and I'm using windows.

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://mattreusswig.shinyapps.io/shinyApp? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error in digest::digest(file.path(appDir, file), algo = "md5", file = TRUE) : 
  The specified file is not readable: \\PGDCVA-01\Users$\matt.reusswig\My Documents\shinyApp/server.R

messages.subject: Re: deployApp() error: file is not readable
parts:
Matthew,

Other uses have reported issues with reading files within R directly from a Windows shares. Would it be possible to move your application files to a local directory? Such as C:\MyApp.

-Andy
